_about: royer-merge change-scoped checks for audiophile-ecommerce (affected-checks.mjs reads this before the toolbox file). Added Oct 28, 2026 in the bottleneck rollout.

checks.name: unit
checks.what: node unit and PGlite regression tests (tests/*.test.ts)

checks.name: ui-quality-gate
checks.what: the UI quality gate on the pages the diff reaches, at promotion QA; merges skip it (main ships at merge, no promotion gate)

checks.name: qa
checks.what: independent royer-qa on the PR's own routes

checks.name: qa-gate
checks.what: QA at the head before merge (the carve-out: auth, payments, data, secrets and deploy config)

audiophile-ecommerce.setup: [ -d node_modules ] || if [ -f bun.lock ]; then b="${BUN:-$HOME/.bun/bin/bun}"; [ -x "$b" ] || b=$(command -v bun) || { echo 'setup: bun.lock but no bun (set BUN or install ~/.bun/bin/bun)' >&2; exit 1; }; NPM_CONFIG_USERCONFIG=/dev/null "$b" install --frozen-lockfile > /dev/null; else npm install --no-audit --no-fund > /dev/null 2>&1; fi
audiophile-ecommerce._setup: Same string as answerbar. This repo stays on npm (package-lock.json): GitHub CI's `npm ci` needs it, and moving CI to Bun changes .github/workflows, a qa-gate path. So setup takes the npm install branch.

boat._setup: No packageManager, so this installs nothing extra; setup runs npm install.

audiophile-ecommerce._ci: GitHub CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml on Mac2's self-hosted runner) runs the full npm test on every PR: setup coverage, the Sites (vinext) build and its HTML contracts, and the layout regression in Google Chrome. Those need Chrome and wrangler, so they aren't profile checks; a merge reads that CI result at the head.
